negative_snippets:
I was charged ₹1200 extra without any valid reason.
When I requested a 1-day extension, the hotel again charged:
•	₹300 for extension
•	₹1200 additional charges
•	Total ₹2700 taken for just 2 nights, despite the app showing a much lower price.
Even after checking in at night, the hotel owner did not mark my check-in on the OYO app, creating further issues.
The hotel owner behaved in an extremely rude, aggressive, and abusive manner.
Most seriously, the owner threatened me, saying “Paise do warna marunga”.
This is a criminal threat and made me feel unsafe.
I was new to the city, it was night time, and due to safety concerns, I had no option but to pay under pressure.

The service is very bad, the staff has no manners to talk to, the rooms are very dirty, if you are a professional then never go to such a hotel, instead of staying in this hotel you should stay in a Dharamshala.
Rude manager staff. Room was bad. Bathroom flush was not working, bathroom door couldn't be locked knob broken. Bedsheet was dirty, blanket was torn.
